hooks.command: first_prompt="$(python3 -c 'import json,sys; data=json.load(sys.stdin); value=data.get("prompt") or data.get("userPrompt") or ""; print(" ".join(str(value).split())[:500])' 2>/dev/null || true)"; if [ -n "${BROOD_PANE_ID:-}" ] && [ -n "${BROODD_DBUS_ADDRESS:-}" ]; then busctl --quiet --address="$BROODD_DBUS_ADDRESS" call "${BROODD_DBUS_DESTINATION:-org.brood.Session}" /org/brood/Agent org.brood.Agent RegisterAgent "sa{ss}" codex 6 pane_id "$BROOD_PANE_ID" status running cwd "${PWD:-}" source codex-hook surface_session "${BROOD_SURFACE_SESSION_ID:-1}" first_user_message "$first_prompt" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi

if [ -n "${BROOD_PANE_ID:-}" ] && [ -n "${BROODD_DBUS_ADDRESS:-}" ]; then busctl --quiet --address="$BROODD_DBUS_ADDRESS" call "${BROODD_DBUS_DESTINATION:-org.brood.Session}" /org/brood/Agent org.brood.Agent RegisterAgent "sa{ss}" codex 5 pane_id "$BROOD_PANE_ID" status done cwd "${PWD:-}" source codex-hook surface_session "${BROOD_SURFACE_SESSION_ID:-1}" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi
